name: Editorial Split Slideshow
description: Full-screen split slideshow with a text panel on the left and a clip-path wipe image on the right, blurred background tint, autoplay and numbered navigation.
contents: Label, serial counter, title, description and numbered buttons
Image panel with one image per slide and a blurred backdrop
behavior: Autoplay advances slides on an interval
Images wipe in with clip-path, fade and scale
Text fades up on each slide change
Numbered buttons jump to a slide
Stacks text above image on mobile
editableByProps: Slides, text, images, label, border color, title font class, autoplay interval (0 disables)

needsCodeEdit.where: bg-zinc-950 and bg-zinc-900/90 classes on the root and card
clipPath style in the image panel

fixed: Imports the Cinzel Google font through a style tag
Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
